Game Overview

In Kimono Fashion, the core idea is straightforward: join Princess Milana on a delightful journey through Japanese fashion. Decorate her space with oriental flair, experiment with diverse makeup styles, and explore stunning, luxurious kimonos. Complete her look with charming accessories and experience a captivating blend of tradition and modernity.
